content.value_statement: Manual Writer document changes are slow and hard to repeat. This skill provides structured Python helpers for ODT editing, formatting, export, and snapshots.
actual_capabilities: Create new Writer ODT documents at absolute paths.
Open session-based editing workflows for text, tables, images, and lists.
Resolve structured targets by text anchors, occurrence, table name, image name, or index.
Apply ordered patch workflows with atomic or best effort modes.
Export Writer documents to PDF or DOCX.
Capture page snapshots as PNG files for layout checks.
limitations: Requires LibreOffice with Python UNO support on the host system.
Writer APIs expect absolute paths for documents and assets.
Target matching can fail when anchors are ambiguous or too short.
It supports Writer document workflows, not spreadsheet or presentation editing.

use_cases.title: Report Editors
use_cases.description: Update recurring reports with text replacements, tables, lists, and consistent formatting.

use_cases.title: Document Automation Developers
use_cases.description: Build repeatable ODT workflows that create files, export PDFs, and capture verification snapshots.

use_cases.title: Proposal Teams
use_cases.description: Patch existing proposals with approved wording and structured tables without manual Writer edits.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Writer Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ODT report at /abs/path/report.odt with a title, two paragraphs, and a short unordered action list.

prompt_templates.title: Format Existing Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Open /abs/path/report.odt, find the sentence after Financial Summary, make it bold, center its paragraph, and save the document.

prompt_templates.title: Patch a Proposal
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply a best effort Writer patch to /abs/path/proposal.odt that replaces Draft with Final, updates the Summary table, and records any failed operation.

prompt_templates.title: Verify Layout and Export
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit /abs/path/report.odt, export it to PDF, create a PNG snapshot of page 1, and summarize the visual checks I should review.

output_examples.input: User asks to create a project brief with sections and a task list.
output_examples.output: The skill creates an ODT file, inserts headings and paragraphs, adds a Writer list, and saves the document.

output_examples.input: User asks to replace a phrase in a contract and format the result.
output: Finds the requested phrase using structured text anchors.
Replaces the text and applies requested Writer formatting.
Reports whether the edit was saved.

output_examples.input: User asks for a PDF and page preview.
output_examples.output: The skill exports the Writer file to PDF and creates a PNG snapshot for layout review.

best_practices: Use absolute file paths for every document, export, image, and snapshot path.
Use full sentence anchors with after and before bounds when editing repeated text.
Run atomic patches when partial document changes would be unacceptable.
anti_patterns: Do not use short common words as edit anchors in long documents.
Do not rely on table or image index when stable names are available.
Do not continue a session after closing it.

faq.question: Does this skill require LibreOffice?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires LibreOffice and Python UNO support on the host system.

faq.question: Can it edit existing ODT files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can open existing Writer documents and modify text, tables, images, lists, and formatting.

faq.question: Can it export documents?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports PDF and DOCX export through LibreOffice Writer filters.

faq.question: How does it target text safely?
faq.answer: It uses structured targets with text, after, before, and occurrence fields to avoid ambiguous edits.

faq.question: Can it verify layout?
faq.answer: It can export a page snapshot as a PNG so users can inspect layout changes.

faq.question: Does it work with spreadsheets?
faq.answer: No. This skill focuses on LibreOffice Writer ODT documents.
